## Description

Jelaskan modul yang dibuat/diubah dan cara kerjanya.

## Type of Change

- [ ] feat
- [ ] fix
- [ ] refactor
- [ ] test
- [ ] docs / chore

## Related Issue

Closes #

## Evidence / Screenshots

Lampirkan sesuai area yang diubah (hapus yang tidak relevan):

- [ ] Mobile: screenshot Compose Preview / screen recording emulator (error state, loading state, sukses & navigasi)
- [ ] Backend: screenshot respons JSON sukses & error (Postman / Thunder Client)
- [ ] DevOps: log unit test / CI hijau (`./gradlew lintDebug`, `./gradlew testDebugUnitTest`, atau test backend)

## Developer Checklist

- [ ] Local testing pass
- [ ] No credentials / .env / local.properties / keystore committed
- [ ] Code follows linting/naming
- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] Sudah `git pull origin main` sebelum push
- [ ] Reviewer sudah ditetapkan di panel kanan
